<?xml version="1.0"?>
<data><PackageEdit>matview</PackageEdit><VerisonEdit>1.0-1</VerisonEdit><SectionBox>3</SectionBox><ShortEdit>A utility to search, copy, and embed material design icons</ShortEdit><LongEdit>This utility allows designers of software to quickly browse through a grid of over 6,000 icons. The incremental search feature quickly jumps between icons of interest. Users can copy the icon as plain text and paste them into their source code. If they prefer they can copy the Unicode code point, or even export icons to image files at any size or scale of their choosing</LongEdit><AuthorEdit>admin@getlazarus.org</AuthorEdit><WebsiteEdit>https://www.getlazarus.org/apps/matview/</WebsiteEdit><AppEdit>/home/gigauser/Development/Pascal/Projects/Codebot/Codebot.MatView/src/matview</AppEdit><CaptionEdit>Material Design Icon Viewer</CaptionEdit><depends>libbsd0 (&gt;= 0.10.0), libcairo2 (&gt;= 1.16.0), libfribidi0 (&gt;= 1.0.8), libgdk-pixbuf2.0-0 (&gt;= 2.40.0+dfsg), libgtk2.0-0 (&gt;= 2.24.32), libpango-1.0-0 (&gt;= 1.44.7), libpangocairo-1.0-0 (&gt;= 1.44.7), libpangoft2-1.0-0 (&gt;= 1.44.7), libpcre2-8-0 (&gt;= 10.34), libpixman-1-0 (&gt;= 0.38.4), libpng16-16 (&gt;= 1.6.37)</depends><icon></icon></data>
